{{Quote|Send out a wide-band distress signal. Indicate that the Senator's ship encountered an unexpected meteorite cluster it could not avoid. Readings indicate that the shift shields were overridden and the ship was hulled to the point of vacating ninety-five percent of its atmosphere. Inform her father and the Senate that all aboard were killed.|Darth Vader, to Commander Daine Jir|<ref name="EP4NOVEL" />}}
A '''shift shield''', also spelled '''shift-shield''', was a type of [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] used to protect [[Starship/Legends|starships]] from [[Asteroid/Legends|meteoroids]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|captured and destroyed]] the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']]. In order to hide his actions from the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], Vader had a distress message sent that blamed the destruction of the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] on the failure of its shift shields.

==Description==
Shift [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] were a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] shield that protected against physical objects such as [[Asteroid/Legends|meteoroids]]. If the shields were overridden, incoming objects could break the hull, causing [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] loss.<ref name="EP4NOVEL" />

==History==
[[File:TantiveIVFinal.png|thumb|right|300px|The ''Tantive IV'' was equipped with shift shields.]]
Shift shields were used on ships by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. That [[Standard year|year]], the Imperial [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']]<ref name="DB-Rebel blockade runners">{{DB|starship|tantiveiv|Rebel blockade runners}}</ref>&mdash;[[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]<ref name="EP4NOVEL" />&mdash;[[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|pursued, captured, and destroyed]] the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] vessel.<ref name="DB-Rebel blockade runners" /> In order to explain the destruction of the vessel to the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], Vader instructed Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Daine Jir/Legends|Daine Jir]] to send a fake distress signal that indicated the ''Tantive IV''{{'s}} shift shields had failed during a meteoroid shower.<ref name="EP4NOVEL" />

The [[Apex Incisor Missile]],<ref name="Fantastic Technology">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref> produced around the same [[Time/Legends|time]]<ref name="Fantastic Technology Date">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]'' places its timeframe during the [[New Republic era]] and states that indicated equipment&mdash;which included the [[Apex Incisor Missile]]&mdash;was available between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|VI}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' date to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], respectively.</ref> by the [[company]] [[Golog-Bertum]], was able to take a mass spectral record of a starship, including its shift-shield output, before it was launched at the target. The [[missile]] was sold<ref name="Fantastic Technology" /> throughout the Galactic Civil War and during the subsequent [[New Republic era|rule]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Fantastic Technology Date" /> In that era, the [[Gundark Arms Ring]] produced a [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Gundark's Gear Datalog|catalog]] that mentioned the incisor missile's ability to record shift-shield outputs.<ref name="Fantastic Technology" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shift shields were first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], ghostwritten by [[Alan Dean Foster]] for [[George Lucas]] and released in [[1976]]<ref name="EP4NOVEL" /> before the film's release in [[1977]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Shift-shields were first spelled with a hyphen in "[[Blasters for Hire]]," a [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']] article written by [[Anthony Russo]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[August]] [[1994]] in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 3|third issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''.<ref name="Blasters for Hire">{{JournalCite|3|Blasters for Hire}}</ref>
